blocks.content: Organizational structure determines the allocation of responsibilities, authority relationships, and channels of communication across an enterprise.

rows: Direct and vertical from top to bottom
Violated as workers report to multiple functional specialists
Small enterprises with simple operational flows
Large enterprises requiring expert division of labor

items: The Principle of Unity of Command is explicitly violated in a Matrix Organizational Structure due to dual reporting lines.
Line-and-Staff structures frequently generate conflict between operational line managers and specialized staff advisors.
Flat structures are characterized by a wide span of control and fewer management levels, whereas tall structures feature narrow spans and multiple hierarchical tiers.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Organizational structure defines how tasks are allocated, coordinated, and supervised to achieve organizational goals.
Line organization is the oldest and simplest structural form, characterized by direct vertical flow of authority.
Functional structure groups employees based on specialized roles and expertise, promoting operational efficiency.
Matrix organization integrates functional and divisional structures, resulting in a dual chain of command.
Span of control determines the number of direct subordinates a supervisor can manage effectively.
